I help my aunt at her small shop. We open the windows in the morning. I put clean bags beside the door. She writes the prices on small cards. A neighbor comes in to buy fresh bread. We smile and wish him a good day.

Our class makes a map of the school. We draw the rooms with different colors. I draw the library beside the hall. My friend adds the garden and the gate. We check the map before we show it. The teacher puts it on the classroom wall.

My father teaches me to fix a loose handle. He brings a small box of tools. I hold the door while he finds the right tool. He turns the screw slowly. We try the handle a few times. Now the door opens and closes well.

We have a picnic beside a quiet lake. My cousin brings a green blanket. I put the sandwiches in the shade. We watch ducks move across the water. After lunch, we play a simple word game. We leave the grass clean when we go home.

A new student joins our class today. I show her the place for her coat. She sits beside me during the lesson. We read a short story together. At lunch, I introduce her to my friends. She tells us about her old school.

I make a card for my grandmother. First, I fold a piece of yellow paper. Then I draw flowers on the front. I write a short message inside. My brother adds a picture of our cat. We put the card in an envelope together.

The lights go out while we are at home. My mother finds a small torch. We sit together near the kitchen window. My father tells us a funny story. We listen to the rain outside. The lights come back before the story ends.

I visit the bakery before school. The baker is putting warm rolls on a tray. I ask for two rolls and a small loaf. He puts them in a paper bag. I pay and count my change. The bread smells good all the way home.

Our family takes a short trip by train. I carry a backpack with water and a book. We find our seats near the middle of the train. My sister points at the fields outside. We share a snack after the first stop. I write the names of the stations in my notebook.

There is a small bird near our garden gate. It sits on the ground beside a bush. We stay far away and watch quietly. Soon, another bird lands on the fence. The little bird flies up to join it. We are glad we did not frighten them.
I want to learn a new song. I listen to the first part twice. Then I sing it slowly with my sister. Some words are hard to say. We read them and try again. By the evening, we can sing the whole song.

My friend and I clean our desks. We put the pencils in a blue pot. Old papers go into the recycling box. I find a ruler behind my books. My friend finds a note from last week. Our desks look neat when we finish.

We walk to the sports center after lunch. My brother carries a ball in his bag. I bring water for both of us. We meet two friends near the entrance. There is room for everyone on the court. We take a break before we walk home.

My neighbor grows vegetables in large pots. She shows me a small green tomato. I can see more tomatoes under the leaves. She waters the pots early in the day. I help her move an empty pot into the shade. She gives me some fresh mint to take home.

I read a recipe for a simple fruit salad. We need apples, bananas, and oranges. My mother helps me cut the fruit. I put the pieces in a large bowl. My little sister brings the spoons. We share the salad after dinner.

We visit a craft fair on Saturday. One person makes cups from clay. Another person sells wooden toys. I stop to watch a woman draw a bird. She uses a very small brush. We thank her before we move to the next table.

I keep a small diary beside my bed. Each night, I write about one good thing. Sometimes I write about a game or a lesson. Sometimes I draw a picture instead. My diary does not need long stories. A few clear words help me remember the day.

My cousin is learning to use a computer. I show him how to open a folder. He finds a picture of our last trip. We give the picture a clear name. Then he saves it in the right place. He wants to try another task by himself.
